description: Single source of truth for redirects and response headers on pequeverso.com. tools/gen-htaccess.ts renders it to out/.htaccess (static target); config/next.ts attaches it as redirects()/headers() (standalone target). The ?offer=downsell alias is handled client-side by the offer-mode script (no redirect, to avoid query-merge loops).

hsts.note: Staged (PV-D9; see docs/migration.md). Production still serves the first stage (300 s), set by the previous config. No `preload`, ever: it is irreversible in practice. The stage in maxAge/includeSubDomains is what the next production deploy (M7) ships; advance one stage per verified step, never skip the gate.

rollout.gate: Live since the first HTTPS deploy; detects a broken HTTPS path cheaply.
Ships with the first main deploy that carries this config (M7). Needs: apex and www answer valid HTTPS (www 308 to apex), TLS expiry above the daily floor, no mixed content.

Seven full days after the previous stage is live and the owner has confirmed that no subdomain of pequeverso.com is served over plain HTTP (DNS inventory in the Cloudflare dashboard). Rollback cost: browsers remember the value for its max-age, so revert only by serving max-age=0 over HTTPS.

redirects.description: WordPress hub path pasted on the new domain.
WordPress and /products/ aliases of the principal landing (query preserved).
Upsell/downsell aliases; ?downsell=1 and attribution params are preserved by both targets.

Affiliate product recommended by Pequeverso (Hotmart course «Guía de Alimentación para Bebés»). Destination = build variable NEXT_PUBLIC_CHECKOUT_URL_ALIMENTACION_BEBE (the owner's hotlink); 302 so the link can change; the visitor's query is appended. Unset variable: no rule, the path 404s.
URLs indexed from the previous owner of pequeverso.com (Montessori shop). Return 410 Gone.

headers.Content-Security-Policy: default-src 'self'; script-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline' https://checkout.hotmart.com https://*.hotmart.com https://connect.facebook.net https://cloud.umami.is; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; img-src 'self' data: https:; font-src 'self'; connect-src 'self' https://*.hotmart.com https://www.facebook.com https://connect.facebook.net https://cloud.umami.is https://api-gateway.umami.dev; frame-src https://*.hotmart.com https://www.facebook.com; media-src 'self'; object-src 'none'; base-uri 'self'; form-action 'self' https://*.hotmart.com; frame-ancestors 'self'

headers.description: Applies to every response (Content-Security-Policy is enforced since M3-5, ADR-0014: script-src keeps 'unsafe-inline' as a documented compensating control until the M5 hash spike; the Cloudflare Web Analytics beacon is deliberately not allowed); later rules override Cache-Control for immutable assets and build-info. HTML is never CDN-cached (Cloudflare/Hostinger CDN respect origin Cache-Control).
Server endpoints (Meta CAPI relay at /api/meta/events) are never cached by Cloudflare or the browser; no redirect rule touches /api/.
